jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest\-growing home improvement company—providing roofing solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.



As a Project Coordinator, you'll be the backbone of the operations team at Timeproof USA, ensuring every roofing project runs smoothly from the moment it's sold to the day it's completed. You'll coordinate communication between homeowners, crews, and suppliers while supporting our Project Managers and Sales Representatives to deliver the ultimate roofing experience to our customers!


**What You'll Do**


* **Coordinate** project schedules, material deliveries, and crew assignments to ensure timely
* **Communicate regularly** with customers to provide updates, confirm appointments, and manage expectations.
* **Review** contracts, permits, and material lists for accuracy and completeness.
* **Track project progress**, input data into CRM systems (i.e., Salesforce), and ensure all documentation is current.
* **Support Project Managers** in resolving scheduling conflicts, order issues, or customer concerns.
* **Collaborate with vendors and suppliers** to verify deliveries and manage inventory needs


**What's In It for You**


* **Competitive Salary** depending on experience ($28\-$30 per hour)
* **Full benefits package** — Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k and PTO
* **Paid world\-class training** and mentorship from industry\-leading experts
* **Career growth opportunities** — advance to Project Manager or Operations Manager positions
* **Supportive team culture** built on communication, collaboration, and recognition
* **Full time schedule** Monday–Friday, with occasional weekend needs.


 **What It Takes to Succeed**


* **Strong organizational and time management skills** — you thrive on structure and deadlines.
* **Excellent communication skills** — both verbal and written, with a professional customer\-first approach.
* **Detail\-oriented mindset** — you notice what others miss and ensure every "i" is dotted and "t" is crossed.
* **Proficient computer literacy** — comfortable navigating CRMs (e. Salesforce) and Microsoft Office applications
* Ability to submit to and pass a Background Check

  


**About Us:**



TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire\-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.



Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity \& Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.



If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.



Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Intake Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Come join an exciting and innovative company that puts the “care” back in healthcare!

  

At KabaFusion, our patients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire GREAT people, period! Our culture celebrates and supports the differences that make us unique. Here, it doesn’t matter what your role is, your hard work and dedication is not only recognized but celebrated. Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

  

About Us:


What started as a single pharmacy in 2010 has grown into KabaFusion becoming the largest privately held home infusion company in the country. We have a national network of pharmacies and nursing offices strategically placed to service 40\+ states. Couple that with over 30 years of combined experience and it’s no wonder why KabaFusion is the industry leader in home infusion.

  

Job Summary:  

This position is responsible for the coordination and supports the intake function, managing intake documentation, payor requirements, and cross\-functional scheduling to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations. This role blends operational rigor with light project management, serving as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to drive process improvements and maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


1\. Write, maintain, and update Intake Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to reflect current workflows, policy changes, and best practices.


2\. Maintain and update the payor handbook, including payor\-specific requirements, timelines, and submission guidelines; track policy changes and translate them into actionable process updates.


3\. Manage calendars and schedule intake\-related meetings across departments (operations, clinical, billing, etc.).


4\. Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, minutes, and follow\-up action items to ensure timely execution.


5\. Maintain project documentation for intake process improvement initiatives, including action logs, scope changes, and post\-project evaluations.


6\. Serve as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to support process improvement project implementation.


7\. Review, categorize, and ensure accurate and timely distribution of incoming faxes and other intake documentation to the appropriate department or stakeholders.


8\. Monitor intake processes for adherence to SOPs and payor requirements; identify recurring issues or bottlenecks and propose solutions.


9\. Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and organizational standards.


10\. Perform other duties as assigned by leadership to support departmental goals.

  

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


Education:

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

  

Experience:  

* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in operations, intake, project coordination, or a related role; healthcare or revenue cycle management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build stakeholder engagement and drive action.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and/or electronic health record or payor portal systems preferred. Skills and Competencies:
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams.

  

What we offer:

* Competitive compensation
* Benefits start on your 1st day of employment
* 401k w 4% match – no waiting or vesting period
* PTO / Floating Holidays / Paid Holidays
* Company paid life insurance, short term disability
* Employee Assistance programs to help with mental health / wellness
* Learning \& Development Programs
* Perks… includes discounts on travel, cell phone, clothing and more…
* Generous employee referral program

  

  

To learn more about KabaFusion, please visit our careers page: https://www.kabafusion.com/careers/

  

Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

jobs.title: Advertising Coordinator (LA Times Studios)
jobs.description:
The L.A. Times Studios LLC vision is to be the premier studio for groundbreaking and impactful storytelling, setting high standards for excellence in content creation and production. We push the boundaries of traditional media, exploring new formats and platforms to reach diverse and global audiences. By championing innovative ideas and diverse voices, we aspire to create a more connected world through storytelling and events supported by robust revenue streams from advertising sales, branded content, event production, products and business development.
  
  

Join a team of creative, collaborative and innovative professionals, apply today using the link below.
  
  

The Advertising Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and execution of advertising campaigns for entertainment clients across print, digital, social, and promotional platforms. This role serves as a key operational liaison between sales, clients, creative teams, and internal departments to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on schedule, and aligned with client objectives. The coordinator manages campaign logistics, monitors performance reporting, and assists with client communications to support revenue generation and strong client relationships.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Coordinate the scheduling, trafficking, and execution of advertising campaigns for entertainment clients across multiple platforms, ensuring campaign assets, deadlines, and specifications are met.
* Serve as a central point of coordination between sales teams, clients, creative services, ad operations, and production teams to ensure campaign deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* Review insertion orders, campaign details, and creative assets to confirm alignment with campaign objectives, advertising specifications, and internal operational processes.
* Support the development of campaign materials including media schedules, proposal documents, presentations, and performance summaries using tools such as Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Track campaign timelines, deliverables, and internal approvals to ensure campaigns launch as scheduled and client expectations are met.
* Assist with campaign reporting by compiling performance data, delivery metrics, and campaign summaries to support account managers and client communications.
* Monitor campaign pacing and flag delivery issues, discrepancies, or operational concerns to appropriate internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate campaign records, documentation, and client information within internal systems and databases.
* Support client service activities by responding to internal and external requests for campaign information, status updates, and documentation.
* Assist with special projects, promotional initiatives, and entertainment marketing programs that support revenue generation and audience engagement.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, or business and 2\+ years of experience in advertising coordination, media operations, campaign management, account support OR 3\+ years of experience in advertising coordination, media operations, campaign management, account support,
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Google Slides, Gmail, and Google Docs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment where priorities and deadlines may shift.
* Work extended hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, as business needs require.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience working in media, entertainment advertising, publishing, or digital advertising environments.
* Familiarity with advertising operations systems, order management systems, or ad\-serving platforms.
* Experience supporting advertising campaigns for film studios, streaming platforms, television networks, or entertainment events.
* Knowledge of digital advertising formats, media planning concepts, and campaign performance metrics.

jobs.description:
KTLA Sales Coordinator/Sales Assistant


KTLA5 is the first commercial TV station licensed west of the Mississippi – join our team and be a part of LA history!


As a Sales Coordinator you will be part of a high paced, innovative, and collaborative team. Employee will handle a variety of routine and non\-routine client requests and tasks from Account Executives and Management.


Responsible for managing a high\-volume of media campaigns throughout the life cycle of each order for KTLA, ANTENNA\-TV, KTLA.com and KTLA\+.


Candidate will collaborate with internal departments required to complete projects as necessary, working across departments at KTLA and with clients to successfully execute campaigns such as media schedules and associated elements, as well as promotional and contest campaigns.


Responsibilities will include but not limited to ensuring the timely and accurate airing of spot and digital schedules, order processing, order confirmations, managing pre\-empts and makegood offers, compare estimated ratings/impressions with actual ratings/impressions to ensure audience delivery, distribution of daily/weekly spot times, execute client recaps, assist with sponsorship fulfillment/trackers and downloading of airchecks. Candidate will generate various weekly and monthly revenue reports, answer sales phone lines, and other duties as assigned. Work with Finance Department and Shared Services for system set up of new accounts, payment liability, and invoice discrepancies, as well as communicate with Traffic Department for order processing and copy issues. Candidate will be cross\-trained on both the local and national sales desk. This fast\-paced and evolving team requires an individual who demonstrates the capability to plan for and manage multiple activities, projects, and deliverables.


* Thrives in a team environment and demonstrates leadership skills
* Highly organized with acute attention to detail and accuracy
* Must have strong written/verbal communication
* Exceptional time management and prioritizing skills with ability to multi\-task
* Action\-oriented with strong execution and follow up skills.
* Excellent analytical skills and must be good with numbers
* High proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong customer service skills
* Working knowledge of sales support systems and databases; WO Traffic, WO OrderConnect, and Medialine
* Associate degree or equivalent related experience in television broadcasting, preferably in sales, advertising or traffic gained either through work experience or classroom study
* Minimum 1 year work experience in a media environment, preferably in sales.

Compensation \- $23\-$25/hr


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.


KTLA will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.


\#LI\-Onsite

Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@ktla.com). Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv .

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Build a Career With a Growing South Bay Real Estate Business**

South Bay Smith is looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to work closely with Alex Smith and become an important part of our family\-owned residential real estate sales and property management business.

Our business is built on long\-term relationships, deep local knowledge, thoughtful strategy, integrity, and treating clients like family. The South Bay is our home, not just our market, and as we grow, we're committed to preserving the personal service and genuine relationships that have built our reputation.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants responsibility, not simply a list of tasks to complete. You'll become an organizational backbone of the business \- keeping priorities moving, supporting clients, bringing consistency and follow\-through to a fast\-moving workday, and gradually taking ownership of increasingly important areas of the company.

As our Executive Assistant \& Client Experience Coordinator, you'll also help make sure every client feels informed, cared for, and confidently guided through what comes next.

If you're the person who naturally brings order to a busy environment, remembers the details, follows through, and takes satisfaction in making things easier for both clients and the people around you, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

**Executive Support \& Organization** 

* Manage Alex's calendar, scheduling, priorities, reminders, email organization, and follow\-up. Keep deadlines, commitments, and next steps visible and moving forward.
* Anticipate what needs attention, resolve loose ends, and create structure around a busy workday that moves between clients, properties, negotiations, meetings, and new opportunities.
* Help protect Alex's time so he can focus on clients, relationships, negotiations, pricing strategy, and business development.
* Maintain organized systems and improve recurring processes so important information and commitments don't depend on memory alone.

**Client Experience \& Real Estate Support** 

Provide warm, professional, responsive support to clients throughout the sales and property management experience.

Coordinate appointments, meetings, showings, inspections, vendors, and other real estate activities.

Assist with transaction administration, documentation, signatures, deadlines, and follow\-up.

Help clients understand what comes next and ensure communication is timely and thoughtful.

Help create a calm, organized client experience even when things become complicated or fast\-moving.

Marketing, Client Engagement \& Community

Assist with mailings, community activities, marketing projects, and relationship\-building initiatives.

Create polished, dynamic social media and digital content that reflects the South Bay Smith brand, captures attention, and stops the scroll.

Turn property photos, video, local knowledge, client stories, and ideas into compelling finished content efficiently, using good judgment about where time and effort will have the greatest impact.

Support email marketing, print materials, presentations, and other marketing initiatives.

Bring creative ideas for staying connected with past clients, reaching new clients, and strengthening our presence in the community.

**Who We're Looking For**

* The right person doesn't need to know everything about real estate on day one. What matters most is how you work. You'll be a strong fit if you naturally keep track of details others miss, enjoy bringing order to a busy environment, and take satisfaction in making sure things actually get done.
* Are exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, reliable, and able to follow through without repeated reminders.
* Think ahead, take initiative, and know when to handle something yourself, when to follow up, and when to bring something to Alex's attention \- while respectfully helping keep priorities on track.
* Are resourceful and self\-directed \- you can take a rough idea or desired outcome, figure out what's needed, and move it toward a polished finished product without step\-by\-step direction.
* Can quickly prioritize competing demands based on deadlines, client impact, and importance while staying calm and organized.
* Communicate early, close the loop, and bring solutions whenever possible \- including facts, options, and a recommendation when Alex's judgment is needed.
* Are an excellent written and verbal communicator who can represent Alex and South Bay Smith warmly and professionally.
* Exercise excellent judgment, discretion, and confidentiality, and stay flexible and solution\-oriented when plans change.
* Are technologically fluent, work efficiently across digital platforms, and adapt quickly to new systems.
* Have strong creative and visual instincts, produce polished and engaging content efficiently, and know how to balance quality with speed.
* Enjoy improving systems, want to learn and earn increasing responsibility, and understand that working in a small business sometimes means stepping outside your usual responsibilities to help with an unexpected task or fill a gap when something needs to get done.
* Local South Bay candidates are strongly preferred. We value someone who knows the area, understands the communities we serve, and feels genuinely connected to the South Bay.

**Experience**

Real estate experience is a plus, but not required. Strong candidates may come from executive or administrative support, business operations, client service, project coordination, marketing/content creation, or another role requiring excellent organization, judgment, and follow\-through.

We're also interested in what else you bring to the table. Maybe you have a great eye for social media and marketing, are exceptionally good at creating systems, are naturally strong with clients, or have another capability that could make a growing small business better.

jobs.title: Property Management & Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**Property Management \& Operations Assistant**

Cross\-Business Administrative Support **Beverly Hills \& Around**

**Job Type**

Full\-time

**Pay**

$60,000 – $80,000 a year (DOE)

**Work Location**

In\-person (Beverly Hills, CA)

**Schedule**

Monday to Friday

**Work Environment**

Mac / iOS ecosystem **Multi\-business office**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an assistant with property management administrative experience to support three businesses run by the same partners:

* Commercial and residential real estate investment, development, and property management.
* Construction defect claims and risk consultancy.
* Pre\-settlement litigation funding.

This is an administrative support position, not an analyst or coordinator role. You won't be making deal or case decisions. Instead, you will be the person keeping daily operations organized across all three companies—handling tenant communications, vendor dispatches, rent rolls, document filing, and general office and executive support. If you have hands\-on experience supporting property management operations and want a role with variety across real estate, consulting, and finance, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

**Property Management Operations \& Real Estate Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day tenant communications, maintenance requests, and vendor follow\-ups.
* Dispatch work orders, track repairs, and keep property maintenance logs current.
* Maintain and update rent rolls, lease files, vendor agreements, and tenant insurance certificates (COIs).
* Support real estate investment deal flow: organize offering materials, compile comps, maintain broker contacts, and track transmittals.
* Format, draft, and organize routine correspondence, counteroffers, and term sheet markups under principal direction.

**Cross\-Business \& General Administrative Support**

* **Construction Defect Support:** Organize incoming case materials, track site inspection logs, assemble exhibits, and keep matter files current.
* **Litigation Funding Support:** Assist with funding intake, gather and organize file documentation, and update CRM records.
* **Executive \& Office Admin:** Coordinate calendars, schedule meetings, monitor inboxes, and prepare meeting materials for the partners.
* **Filing \& Document Organization:** Scan, name, and file documents into SharePoint and cloud drives so everything is easy to find.
* **Spreadsheets \& Tracking:** Build and maintain clean tracking sheets, checklists, and logs in Excel.
* **AI \& Automation:** Use tools like Claude or ChatGPT to speed up drafting, data entry, and routine administrative research.
* **General Office Support:** Handle mail, deliveries, supply orders, and occasional local errands to keep the office running smoothly.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Property Management Admin Experience:** Direct administrative experience handling tenant correspondence, vendor dispatch, rent rolls, lease files, or maintenance logs.
* **Follow\-Through:** You take ownership of your task list, stay organized, and close loops on your own without needing multiple reminders.
* **Software Skills:** Fluent in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint). Comfortable working in a Mac / iOS environment.
* **AI Comfort:** Willing and comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to work faster and cut down on repetitive manual work.
* **Discretion:** You will see sensitive financial, legal, and tenant information daily. Total confidentiality is required.
* **In\-Person Availability:** Able to work on\-site Monday through Friday in our Beverly Hills location.

**Compensation \& Growth**

* **Base Pay:** $60,000 – $80,000 per year, depending on direct property management and administrative experience.
* **Opportunity:** Direct day\-to\-day exposure to how three active businesses run. Compensation can grow as you take on more responsibility.

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief note summarizing your property management administrative experience and the primary software tools you use daily.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable working physically in the office 5 days a week?
* Do you own a car?
* Do you live within a 30 minute drive from Beverly Hills?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Help Us Build the Next Version of Our Operations Team**

We are a growing logistics company, and we are looking for people who want to do more than simply perform a job.

We want **critical thinkers, passionate workers, problem solvers, and future leaders** who are excited about helping build a company while it is growing.

Our company is still evolving. That means not every process is perfect, not every problem has already been solved, and not every system has already been built.

**That is the opportunity.**

If you are the type of person who notices inefficiencies and immediately starts thinking about how they could be improved, we want to meet you.

If you enjoy solving problems, creating structure, taking ownership, and making an operation better than you found it, this may be the right environment for you.

You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas, improve workflows, challenge inefficient processes, and help shape how our Operations Department functions as the company grows.

We are not looking for someone who only asks:

**“What do you want me to do?”**

We are looking for someone who also asks:

**“Why are we doing it this way?”**

**“Is there a better way?”**

**“What problem are we trying to solve?”**

and

**“How can I help make this operation stronger?”**

But this position is about more than completing transactions.

As you learn the operation, we expect you to **think critically about the work you are doing.**

Where are we losing time?

Where are mistakes happening?

What information is missing?

What could be automated?

What process could be simplified?

What could make communication between Sales and Operations better?

What could allow the company to handle more freight without sacrificing service?

Your ideas matter here.

Our goal is to build a team where employees do not simply work **inside** the operation—they help improve it.

* Strong communicator who people trust to give them a straight answer.

**Why this role is worth your time:**

This seat has real room to grow. As our California region expands, this is a role we expect to develop toward greater operations leadership over time. We're hiring for that trajectory — bring your ambition.

jobs.description:
**About WPP Media**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.



WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.



For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

**Role Summary \& Impact**  

As an Out\-of\-Home Manager, you will lead strategic OOH planning and buying across traditional and digital formats. You will manage campaigns from briefing through recommendation, negotiation, production, posting, measurement, and reconciliation, while serving as a key partner to clients, media owners, and internal teams.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop OOH strategies based on client objectives, audiences, markets, locations, and the right mix of traditional and digital formats.
* Lead market research, inventory evaluation, RFPs, proposal analysis, and media\-owner negotiations.
* Prepare clear recommendations, contracts, budgets, flowcharts, posting instructions, timelines, and creative specifications.
* Manage campaigns through production, installation, posting, proof\-of\-performance, maintenance, and completion.
* Partner with clients, planning teams, media owners, production vendors, creative agencies, finance, and analytics to deliver campaigns on strategy, on budget, and on time.
* Monitor campaign delivery, resolve posting, production, quality, and billing issues, and maintain accurate financial records.
* Review OOH creative for legibility, scale, viewing environment, and format requirements.
* Present recommendations and campaign results, maintain strong partner relationships, and stay current on OOH market opportunities.
* Manage workflow, review team output, mentor junior staff, and serve as an escalation point.


**Requirements**  

  



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in OOH planning, buying, investment, or activation.
* Strong knowledge of traditional and digital OOH formats, media owners, market research, location strategy, production, and measurement.
* Experience managing multi\-market plans, RFPs, negotiations, budgets, campaign execution, billing, and reconciliation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with OOH planning and mapping tools is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems proactively, and coach junior team members.


**Life at WPP Media \& Benefits**

  


Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.



WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. **Essent Group Ltd.** (NYSE: ESNT) is a Bermuda\-based holding company (collectively with its subsidiaries, "Essent") which serves the housing finance industry by offering private mortgage insurance, reinsurance, risk management products and title insurance and settlement services to mortgage lenders, borrowers, and investors to support homeownership. We are focused on managing risk and dedicated to serving as a strong and fair counterparty. As a company, we bring strong private capital and a commitment to risk management to the mortgage insurance industry.

  


**Title**: Account Manager

  


**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (Remote)



This is a key role within the team that acts as an individual contributor which operates under limited supervision. The Account Manager will represent Essent to small and midsized lenders. Responsible for the advancement of lender relationships to maximize Essent’s position within the assigned account base and development of new market opportunities.
 

**As a dynamic and resourceful professional, we will rely on you to perform the following duties:**


* Represent Essent to assigned accounts within a specified regional territory to deliver value added credit enhancement solutions while driving profit to the business.
* Responsible for the success and profitability of each account.
* Represent Essent to designated lender “Key Locations” within the assigned territory.
* Develop a thorough understanding of assigned accounts with respective business models and obtain detailed knowledge of how they operate.
* Build strong client relationships to support current business needs and acquire new customers.
* Collaborate with internal departments to fulfill customer’s request.
* Identify market opportunities, structures, and penetration strategies for new products/programs to fit clients’ needs and help differentiate Essent in the market.
* Work in collaboration with clients, internal operations, and credit policy to manage coordination of product, pricing, and credit implementation programs.
* Meet timelines for each client’s initiative, request and project, including implementation, client and internal roll\-out, collateral and presentation materials.
* Evaluate competitive market trends and new regulations related to products, rates, guidelines, and/or ancillary services.
* Develop tactics to leverage current market trends and optimize sales potential.
* Develop understanding of GSE requirements for mortgage insurance industry, PMIERs and Master Policy.
* Facilitate and educate clients on new programs, rates, products, and initiatives.
* Focus on profitability and mutually beneficial arrangements with regional accounts to create a sustainable alignment of interest.
* Explore cost effective origination strategies capitalizing on Essent’s strengths while delivering superior customer service.
* Represent Essent at client meetings, attend regional, state conferences, trade shows and events to promote Essent’s product offerings and broaden the business exposure within the mortgage industry.
* Present Essent within the entire mortgage industry as thought leaders, disciplined risk managers and a strong focus on servicing our customers.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.


**Minimum Education \& Experience Requirements:**


* Bachelor ‘s degree strongly preferred.
* Three (3\) years or more of relevant business development experience within financial services or mortgage industry.
* Solid understanding of the economics of mortgage banking and how Essent’s customers operate and profit, required.
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Due to Essent’s unique culture within the mortgage insurance industry, the successful candidate must demonstrate a personal initiative towards helping to build a successful company, the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and get work done and possess strong work ethic and entrepreneurial skills.
* Ability to travel up to approximately 30%.
* Account base is concentrated in a regional or state footprint. Preferred that candidates live within their market.

* Excellent verbal, written communication, and presentation skills.
* A demonstrated history of leadership and ownership, along with the ability to drive strategic initiatives from concept to completion.
* Ability to interact with senior level decision makers, vendors and clients in a professional manner and discuss Essent and its products and services at a high level.
* Experience developing and cultivating relationships with customers, clients, vendors and colleagues of various levels and backgrounds.
* Strong time management, organizational and planning skills.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, drive and work ethic.

  



Our commitment to your success is enhanced by our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401(k) and disability benefits. We work to maintain a positive environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. Essent is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are seeking a creative, analytical, and results\-driven **Digital Marketing Manager** to lead and grow our digital marketing efforts across paid advertising, social media, search, email, website, and other digital channels.

We are looking for someone who is both strategic and willing to execute. You should be comfortable launching campaigns, testing new ideas, analyzing performance, collaborating with other teams, creating and coordinating content, and continuously looking for new ways to grow our brand, audience, leads, and revenue.

A major focus of this position will be **paid digital advertising, performance measurement, social media growth, and creative experimentation** across platforms including Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other emerging or relevant marketing channels.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, launch, manage, and optimize paid digital advertising campaigns across **Google Ads, Meta/Facebook/Instagram, LinkedIn Ads**, and other relevant advertising platforms.

* Develop creative ideas for social posts, advertising campaigns, videos, graphics, promotions, educational content, and other initiatives that strengthen the brand.
* Monitor social media trends, competitors, new advertising opportunities, and emerging marketing platforms to identify ideas worth testing.
* Develop and execute SEO and content strategies designed to increase organic website traffic and search visibility.
* Manage and optimize website content and landing pages using platforms such as WordPress or similar content management systems.
* Coordinate the creation of marketing materials including advertisements, landing pages, email campaigns, graphics, videos, blog content, and social media content.
* Develop and manage email marketing, remarketing, lead nurturing, and marketing automation campaigns.
* Continuously improve conversion rates across advertisements, landing pages, website forms, and other points throughout the customer journey.

What We're Looking For

* Experience collaborating with sales or other departments to evaluate lead quality, campaign effectiveness, and revenue impact.

* Experience with graphic design, video, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar creative tools is a plus.

* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Ideal Candidate

jobs.title: Service Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Services Sales Representative creates, advances, and closes profitable service opportunities across our customer base and target markets. The role turns hardware\-led conversations into complete operational outcomes: identifying customer needs, shaping the right service solution, coordinating technical scoping, and guiding opportunities from discovery through contract handoff.  

The mandate is to grow recurring and project\-based services revenue and increase service attachment to product sales, without sacrificing delivery quality, gross margin, or customer expectations. The right candidate is a disciplined consultative seller who can translate complex drone, autonomy, security, training, compliance, and support capabilities into clear business value. **Responsibilities:** ***Pipeline \& Opportunity Ownership**** Build and maintain a qualified services pipeline through outbound prospecting, account expansion, product\-sales collaboration, marketing leads, referrals, partners, and industry events.
* Identify opportunities to attach services to drone, dock, payload, robotics, software, and ArgusLine trailer sales.
* Qualify on business need, operational readiness, technical fit, budget, authority, timing, and risk.
* Own follow\-up cadence, stakeholder mapping, and progression through defined CRM stages.

 ***Discovery \& Solution Development**** Lead structured discovery into use cases, sites, workflows, performance expectations, compliance constraints, and purchasing process.
* Translate needs into the right service pathway, engaging services leadership or technical specialists when deeper scoping is required.
* Develop statements of work, proposals, estimates, and customer presentations using approved offerings, pricing rules, and templates.
* Manage pricing and negotiation within approved authority, protecting target margin and escalating nonstandard terms or delivery risk.

 ***Cross\-Functional Selling \& Handoff**** Partner with product sales early so the customer gets a deployment\-ready solution rather than a hardware\-only transaction.
* Coordinate technical discovery, site assessments, demonstrations, and pilots with the right subject\-matter experts.
* Complete a documented sales\-to\-delivery handoff covering scope, assumptions, contacts, schedule, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and open risks.
* Stay commercially engaged after kickoff to support customer communication, change orders, renewals, references, and additional service adoption.

 ***CRM, Forecasting \& Discipline**** Keep CRM records complete and current: value, stage, close date, products and services, stakeholders, activities, risks, and next action.
* Submit reliable weekly forecasts, identify pipeline gaps early, and execute corrective prospecting.
* Follow approved contracting, pricing, discount, legal review, data handling, export\-control, and aviation compliance processes.

 ***Services Portfolio***
You will become conversant across our services portfolio and know when to bring in a specialist: implementation and professional services, managed autonomy and remote operations, BVLOS readiness and ComplianceOps, role\-based training, support and care programs, data services including mapping, inspection, thermal and LiDAR, and ArgusLine mobile security trailer services. **Qualifications:** ***Required**** Three or more years of B2B consultative sales, solutions sales, or professional services sales. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Experience selling services, managed services, technical support, training, consulting, or complex solutions involving multiple stakeholders.
* Able to run discovery, qualify opportunities, build a business case, develop proposals, and negotiate to close through a structured process, with attention to commercial and scope detail.
* Able to learn technical concepts quickly and explain them to operational and executive audiences.
* Willing to travel for customer meetings, site visits, demonstrations, and industry events.

 ***Preferred**** Experience in commercial drones, autonomous systems, robotics, physical security, public safety, industrial inspection, energy, or aviation.
* Familiarity with drone\-in\-a\-box deployments, remote operations, mapping or inspection workflows, aviation compliance, or technical training.
* Experience selling through product\-sales teams, channel partners, integrators, or public\-sector procurement.
* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, or willingness to obtain it within a mutually agreed period after hire.

**Work Environment:** In\-office with occasional local jobsite visits  
**Compensation:** $30–$34 per hour, depending on experience  
**Location Requirement:** Local candidates only; must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office

**About Custom Construction Management**

Custom Construction Management provides professional project management and project coordination services for custom residential construction projects.

We work alongside homeowners, builders, architects, interior designers, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors to help keep projects organized, moving forward, and aligned from pre\-construction through project completion.

Our approach is hands\-on, detail\-oriented, and communication\-driven. We focus on project organization, scheduling, documentation, coordination, and consistent follow\-through to help create a smoother construction experience for our clients and project teams.

**About the Position**

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive **Project Coordinator / Assistant Project Manager** to join our team and support the management of multiple custom residential construction projects.

This position will work closely and side\-by\-side with the Project Manager to coordinate day\-to\-day project activities, maintain schedules and documentation, communicate with subcontractors and vendors, and ensure outstanding items are consistently followed through to completion.

This is a **full\-time, in\-person position**. We believe successful project coordination requires close collaboration, consistent communication, and hands\-on involvement with the project team.

Occasional local travel to project jobsites will be required for meetings, project coordination, documentation, and progress reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple custom residential construction projects
* Maintain and update project schedules, task lists, deadlines, and project milestones
* Coordinate with subcontractors, vendors and other members of the project team
* Proactively follow up with vendors regarding material selections, lead times, deliveries, and outstanding project items
* Maintain project information and documentation within **Buildertrend** or other project management systems
* Track RFIs, submittals, selections, change\-related documentation, approvals, and outstanding decisions
* Assist with subcontractor bid coordination, proposal collection, and scope comparisons
* Assist with preparing and organizing project scopes of work
* Coordinate material procurement and track long\-lead items and anticipated delivery dates
* Prepare and maintain meeting agendas, meeting notes, action\-item lists, and follow\-up items
* Review architectural plans, specifications, selections, and other construction documents for project coordination purposes
* Maintain organized digital project files, records, and correspondence
* Communicate project updates, outstanding items, potential delays, and coordination issues to the Project Manager
* Coordinate between the office and field teams to help resolve scheduling and information gaps
* Occasionally visit local jobsites to attend meetings, document progress, verify project information, and assist with coordination
* Assist with punch\-list coordination and project closeout documentation
* Help identify upcoming project needs and follow through on outstanding action items before they become delays

**This position does not include accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, accounts payable, or accounts receivable responsibilities.**

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:

Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. **Working at Abbott**

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Free medical coverage for employees\* via the Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO

* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**


This position works out of our Alameda, CA location in the Diabetes Care division where we're focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life\-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better\-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.


As the CAPA Project Coordinator you will manage the continuous improvement projects related to the Corrective/Preventive Action process.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Prepares project plans, schedules and budgets by using project management tools


such as Microsoft Project and by working with appropriate staff to understand tasks


necessary to complete project.

* Execute projects by creating tasks, tracking project schedules, identifying risks, and


developing and executing contingency plans.

* Communicates project status by preparing standard status reports, and by


participating in departmental and internal customer project status update meetings.

* Resolves project issues by working with team members, project customers, and others


as appropriate.

* Participates in external project management organizations, conferences and seminars


to keep current with industry best practices in project management by joining


professional associations and implementing a professional development plan with


focus on project management.

* Cultivates a wide range of internal networks and begins to develop an extensive


external network of resources to facilitate completion of tasks.

* May lead a project team of moderate scope.
* Influence exerted at peer level and occasionally at first levels of management.
* Plans, organizes, and prioritizes own daily work routine to meet established


schedule.

* Exercises authority and judgment within defined limits to determine appropriate action
* Failure to achieve results or erroneous decisions or recommendations may cause delays in program schedules and may result in the allocation of additional resources.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
* Minimum 2 years of related work experience with a good understanding of specified functional area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree
* Working technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices and procedures.
* General understanding of business unit/group function.
* Will perform this job in a quality system environment.
* Failure to adequately perform tasks can result in noncompliance with governmental regulations.
* Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of identifiable factors.
* Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.
* Has a broad knowledge of technical alternatives and an understanding of their impact on the systems environment.

  

The base pay for this position is $81,500\.00 – $141,300\.00\. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Supply Chain Properties
jobs.description:
**Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**


Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off\-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high\-quality brands and on\-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.


As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **Career growth**. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow\<
* **Teamwork**. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality \& Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

  

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2023 revenues of $20\.4 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **GENERAL PURPOSE**


The Project Coordinator for Supply Chain Properties will be located at our Dublin Office and will report to the Vice President of Real Estate \- Supply Chain Properties. This role will primarily provide project coordination and administrative support for construction projects and portfolio management. The existing Supply Chain portfolio consists of over 20 million square feet in multiple locations with several high\-profile projects and programs underway.

### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Maintain PDSL site information and manage project documentation to ensure accuracy, organization, and accessibility
* Process pay applications and change orders for construction and capital projects, ensuring completeness and timely submission
* Assist with vendor contract administration, including tracking, documentation, and execution compliance
* Act as a liaison between internal stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and consultants to ensure clear and timely communication
* Maintain and update project planners to reflect current schedules, milestones, and status
* Support lease administration activities, including facilitating lease summary revisions and document packaging for Real Estate Committee (REC) review
* Coordinate and facilitate meetings across all project phases, including land acquisition, design, construction, and project closeout
* Support development of project presentations and status updates for leadership and cross\-functional teams
* Assist in preparation of Capital Expenditure Request (CER) decks and supporting documentation
### **COMPETENCIES**


Collaboration
Leading by Example
Communicates Effectively
Ensures Accountability \& Execution
Manages Conflict
Plans, Aligns \& Prioritizes
Budget and Payment Tracking
Stellar Interpersonal Skills
Data and Document Management
Strong Organization and Time Management Skills### **QUALIFICATIONS \& SPECIAL SKILLS REQUIRED**

* 2\-4 years experience in a real estate, construction, or engineering environment
* Project administration experience preferred
* Strong planning and organizational skills
* Proficient in Word, PowerPoint and Excel
### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


Job requires ability to work in an office environment, primarily on a computer
Requires sitting, standing, walking, hearing, talking on the telephone, attending in\-person meetings, typing, and working with paper/files, etc
Consistent timeliness and regular attendance
Vision requirements: Ability to see information in print and/or electronically
This role requires regular in\-office presence, including to engage in in\-person team interaction, meetings and collaboration, client support, mentoring, coaching, and/or feedback
However, this role can perform duties effectively using a combination of in\-office and remote work
Available for minimal travel### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**


N/A

The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards vary by position and location.

jobs.description:

------------------------


In this role, you will report to the Supervisor of Operation Specialist and will work closely with the Avantor’s Lab and Production Services professionals to serve our customers by performing customized, mission\-based lab work and research protocols that help return time back to science.


**Hourly Rate:** $27 \- $31

**Shift:** Monday–Friday, 7 am – 4 pm or 8 am \- 5 pm

* Previous experience working in a GMP facility is strongly desired
* Strong communication skills

* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Traveling between multiple locations in the San Francisco area
* Mileage reimbursement for miles driven to client locations
* Having a CDL is a plus, not a requirement

* Forklift Certification is a plus

* Works closely with management to complete projects such as Standard Operating Procedures, Scopes of Work, Standard Work, On\-The\-Job Training, and other assorted tasks, along with direct customer interfacing relative to job functions.
* Interfaces directly with customer Point\-of\-Contact, purchasing directors, facility directors, and plant managers etc. to procure lab supplies and materials.

* Provides SAP Support (Full customer services, credit rebills, and invoice scrubbing).

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.

jobs.description:

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Production Coordinator to support our roofing company’s project operations. In this role, you will assist with day\-to\-day production tasks, manage paperwork, and coordinate communication between project managers, customers, and vendors. The ideal candidate will be proactive, efficient, and capable of handling multiple administrative responsibilities to ensure smooth project execution.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Part-Time Marketing Coordinator: North Bay
jobs.description:
**About Sports Basement**


Since 1998, Sports Basement has been more than a sporting goods store \- we're a community hub offering the best brands at Basement prices, with giving back baked into our DNA. What started as a weekend\-only shop in a San Francisco warehouse has grown into multiple fully stocked Bay Area locations, several newly opened Southern California stores, in\-house snow and bike shops, a thriving rentals program, and a robust e\-commerce website at sportsbasement.com. We've come a long way, and we couldn't be prouder of the company we've become.

 **Our Mission**


We're here to help our communities shine a little brighter, live a little greener, and make the outdoors more fun and accessible for everyone. Because your gear is more than just stuff, and we're more than just a store.

 **Our Core Values**


A lot of companies say they care about customers, community, and the environment. We do too \- but what sets us apart is how we actually live those values every day. A few principles that guide us:

* Couches before profit
* Economical vs. Extravagant
* Volunteer vs. Donate
* Proximity vs Productivity
* O.K. is not O.K.
* Doers vs. Degrees
* Creativity before efficiency
* Autonomy before rules
* YES! vs. NO
* Safety before speed

 **Benefits**


Sports Basement offers competitive wages with real opportunities for advancement. Starting pay varies by location and experience \- but the perks go well beyond the paycheck:

* Full health, dental, and vision coverage (full\-time staff)\*
* Profit\-sharing bonus pool\*
* 40% off our already low prices — for life (after 2,000 hours worked)
* A fully stocked kitchen with free breakfast, lunch, and/or dinner
* A free flight for every year\-equivalent of hours worked
* Free skiing, camping, and biking trips through our Out of the Basement program
* Free use of rental gear
* 40% reimbursement on out\-of\-pocket costs for individual sports activities
* 401(k) plan
* Company ESOP retirement program\*
* Flexible scheduling for students
* Seasonal team members are not eligible for our bonus program, ESOP, or health care plan.
 **About the role**

**Part\-Time Marketing Coordinator: North Bay**
===============================================

**Part\-Time · Santa Rosa \& Novato, CA**

**Reports to:** Sr. Director of Marketing

**Compensation:** $25–$27 an hour, non\-exempt position (part\-time, 20 hours/week). Specific starting wage is dependent on experience.

**Full Description Summary:**


A Clubs \& Leagues Partnerships Coordinator is someone who is detail\-oriented and has a passion for connecting with the local sports community. This part\-time role represents Sports Basement in the field, building and managing relationships with the soccer clubs, rugby clubs, little leagues, and other organized team sports organizations that keep our Santa Rosa and Novato stores connected to the community. You'll support and grow these partnerships to introduce and drive new customers to our stores and create Sports Basement advocates. The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills (written and verbal), enthusiasm for youth and adult sports, excellent organizational and relationship\-management skills, and genuine energy for being out in the community.

 **What you'll do**

* Work closely with the Sr. Director of Marketing to build and manage relationships with soccer clubs, rugby clubs, little leagues, and other organized team sports organizations in the North Bay
* Negotiate and onboard new club and league partners
* Implement best practices for club and league partnerships that are both inspiring and motivating to store staff and management
* Research and identify clubs and leagues that have yet to be reached in the Santa Rosa and Novato market
* Actively demonstrate commitment to the growth and success of our organized team sports partnerships, developing strategies to make the channel more impactful season over season
* Demonstrate reliability by working collaboratively and independently to deliver high\-quality work with little supervision
* Maintain awareness of all company information and quickly implement all initiatives to improve business culture
* Keep the North Bay partner database current and report on partnership performance and revenue
* Prioritize cultivating an environment of diversity and inclusion


Apply Core Values

* Implement company core values, policies, procedures, and safety measures
* Demonstrate the SB value “OK is not OK” in all aspects of your role
* Demonstrate good judgment in all situations
* Remain positive in challenging situations and offer creative solutions to problems


Marketing Duties

* Partnership development and stewardship that delights every club and league we work with
* Researching and identifying new clubs, leagues, and organized team sports opportunities that showcase Sports Basement as so much more than retail
* Internal and external communication for all club and league partnerships
* Represent Sports Basement at games, tournaments, and league events, delivering an experience that energizes Sports Basement advocates
* Business Development: Support the marketing team in securing new club and league partnership opportunities


Staff Experience

* Create an inviting ambiance by maintaining a clean, organized, and safe work environment for customers and staff
* Efficiently prioritize and execute daily tasks/goals, and projects to achieve organizational goals in a timely manner, independently or as a team


Business Experience

* Stay up\-to\-date on the next club or league opportunity worth pursuing
* Stay up\-to\-date with all company information and quickly implement department initiatives
* Work closely with the marketing team to utilize reports and other tools to make decisions that positively impact partnership performance and sales

**Qualifications**

* Previous retail or industry experience
* Recent experience in grassroots marketing and community outreach, preferably with clubs,

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager – Residential Remodeling
jobs.description:
**Today’s Kitchen \& Bath Livermore, California \| Full\-Time \| In\-Person$90,000–$105,000 per year, plus performance bonus**

**About Today’s Kitchen \& Bath**

Today’s Kitchen \& Bath is an established, multi\-million\-dollar design\-build remodeling company with approximately 25 employees. We specialize in kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs and complete home remodeling.

We have been in business for 12 years and are proud to be Diamond Certified, BBB accredited with an A\+ rating, and a member of the National Kitchen \& Bath Association.

We have built a strong, respected company and are ready to take the next step. Our goals include improving our internal systems, strengthening accountability, expanding into additional locations and building a leadership team that can support continued growth.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a strong, modern Business Operations Manager to oversee office accountability, sales follow\-through, project readiness, internal systems and client experience.

This person will work directly with the owner and have meaningful authority to make operational decisions and approvals. The successful candidate will identify problems, develop solutions, assign responsibility and follow through until the work is completed correctly.

This is not an administrative assistant or order\-taking position. We need a proactive leader who can hold employees accountable, improve how the company operates and help prepare us for future growth.

The Business Operations Manager is not expected to personally complete everyone’s work. Their responsibility is to ensure the appropriate team members complete their responsibilities accurately and on time.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead daily office and sales accountability
* Schedule and run structured weekly meetings
* Assign responsibilities, establish deadlines and track completion
* Ensure project books are accurate and completed on time
* Track designs, selections, client approvals and production readiness
* Ensure sales\-to\-production handoffs are complete
* Confirm materials and deliveries are properly handled by the responsible team members
* Follow up on unanswered questions and unfinished assignments
* Monitor client communication and ensure customers receive timely responses
* Serve as an escalation point for customer concerns
* Track warranties, punch\-list items and unresolved client issues
* Work with production leadership to improve project completion and customer satisfaction
* Improve internal systems, workflows and communication
* Implement dashboards, scorecards and performance reporting
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation
* Make routine operational decisions and approvals within established guidelines

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Sausalito, California
We inspire purpose\-filled living that brings beauty and quality to the modern home. Together, we achieve. Associates across our business drive results, innovate, and inspire. Drawn together by our shared values and passion for our customers and our brands, we deliver home furnishings that are expertly designed, responsibly sourced, and bring timeless style and function to people’s homes. From the day we opened our first store in Chicago in 1962 to the digital innovations that engage millions of customers today, our iconic brand is over 60 years in the making—and our story is still unfolding.



We’re here for it. We think ***you should be too.***


The Product Development Coordinator supports the end\-to\-end creation of new products, from initial concept through final production. They manage vendor communication, sample tracking, and cross\-functional collaboration with design, merchandising, and sourcing teams. Additionally, they maintain accurate development files, timelines, and product specifications to ensure smooth execution.
**This is an on\-site position based out of our Hudson Grace office in Sausalito, CA.**

 **A day in the life as a Product Development Coordinator...**

 **Product Development:**

* Support the development of new products from initial concept through final production
* Maintain product development calendars, timelines, and critical path schedules
* Create and maintain detailed product specifications, product information, and development files
* Coordinate samples, prototypes, color approvals, finishes, materials, packaging, and revisions
* Track product changes and communicate updates to internal teams and vendors
* Review samples for accuracy, quality, construction, color, finish, and overall aesthetic
* Assist with costing, pricing, minimum order quantities, and margin analysis
* Help identify and resolve product development issues and production challenges

 **Vendor \& Factory Coordination:**

* Communicate regularly with domestic and international vendors and manufacturers
* Request samples, quotes, specifications, and production updates
* Follow up on outstanding approvals, samples, and deadlines
* Maintain organized vendor records and product documentation
* Assist with negotiating product details, costs, lead times, and production requirements as needed

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with Design and Merchandising teams to translate creative concepts into commercially viable products
* Collaborate with Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and Production teams to ensure smooth product execution
* Communicate product status, delays, and critical issues clearly to stakeholders
* Participate in product review meetings and sample evaluations

 **Product Data \& Organization:**

* Maintain accurate product information across internal systems and development tools
* Organize product images, samples, specifications, CADs, drawings, and other development materials.
* Ensure all product details are accurate and up to date before products move into production.
* Assist with seasonal line reviews and product assortment preparation.

 **What you'll bring to the table...**

* A proactive team player who thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Strong interest and understanding of interior design, home furnishings, and luxury lifestyle products
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to proactively identify issues
* Ability to review product samples critically and communicate design or quality changes clearly

 **We'd love to hear from you if you have…**

* 2 years of experience in product development, merchandising, sourcing, production, or a related field, preferably within home, furniture, tabletop, textiles, or luxury consumer goods
* BFA or BS in related design field preferred
* Experience in merchandising and/or related experience
* Experience with product lifecycle management, ERP, or product information systems a plus
* Proficient in Google Suites and Microsoft Office (especially Excel, Google Sheets)
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop

Pay ranges will be adjusted upward as needed to comply with applicable state and local law. In addition to your salary, based on your role, associates may be eligible for other compensation including bonuses, sales incentives, and long term incentives.

jobs.title: Admin Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Uses skills as a seasoned and experienced administrative operations professional to manage, plan, and administer operational and facilities functions for the Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI), spanning several locations. Provides day\-to\-day operational coordination for CNEI, ensuring consistent standards, procedures, and working conditions across multiple CNEI locations. Demonstrates good judgment in independently coordinating operational and administrative processes and prioritizing multi\-site logistics.


**Department Overview**

The Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI) is a support department with five main divisions: Nursing Professional Development, Nursing Quality and Analytics, Clinical Practice, Nursing Continuous Improvement and Research, and Magnet Recognition Program®. The Professional Development team includes Nursing Professional Development Specialists who oversee the Department of Nursing’s training and education needs. The Nursing Practice team includes Clinical Nurse Specialists and Advanced Practice Specialists, who oversee evidence\-based practice standards that optimize quality and safety patient outcomes. The Research \& Scholarship team includes Nurse Scientists and a Scholarship Development Specialist who oversee the infrastructure for clinical inquiry, research, and innovation. The Nursing Continuous Improvement team oversees continuous improvement and evidence\-based practice processes across the system. The Nursing Quality and Analytics team includes nursing quality analysts who oversee data production, dissemination, and analytics. The Magnet Program Director collaborates with CNEI, Nursing leaders, and the Nursing Department to advance excellence in accordance with Magnet Recognition Program® standards. The mission of the CNEI team is to prepare and support UCSF nurses to be expert clinicians and authentic leaders who provide high\-quality, compassionate care, foster the spirit of clinical inquiry, promote professional development, and enhance a culture of diversity and inclusivity.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of administrative operations or facilities coordination experience.
* Thorough knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for facilities and logistics.
* Interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
* Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as supply purchasing, expense tracking, event planning, inventory, equipment, and facilities record keeping.
  

Solid knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs (Office 365, Drupal, ServiceNow).
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Strong skills in short\-term planning, analysis, problem\-solving, and customer service.
* Strong customer service orientation across all locations and able to run operations on competing site\-level priorities.
* Ability to coordinate and prioritize work across multiple locations with minimal supervision.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of workplace safety regulations and experience serving as site safety coordinator or liaison.
* Project management certification from a reputable organization such as PMP, CSM, or ACP to include a qualifying exam and/or quality assurance processes like Six Sigma or Lean or equivalent project management experience.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, compassionate, and detail\-oriented professional who excels at providing seamless administrative support in a vibrant care environment? We are seeking an energetic **Center Coordinator – Adult Day Program** to support operational excellence and foster a warm, inclusive community for older adults.


In this dynamic, key support role, you will work under the supervision of the Adult Day Program Manager to ensure smooth daily center operations, including activity logistics, caregiver scheduling, transportation routing, and electronic recordkeeping. You will serve as an essential ambassador for our patients and community members, championing a welcoming, empowering environment with a strong commitment to serving diverse populations, including LGBTQ seniors. If you thrive in an engaging, fast\-paced setting and love helping others, we encourage you to apply!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Operations \& Care Coordination**

* **Center Administration:** Provide broad administrative and operational support across daily program activities, meal services, personal care scheduling, intake needs, and patient/staff safety protocols.
* **Caregiver Team Support:** Collaborate with program management to assist in overseeing the caregiver team, including coordinate scheduling and daily workflow support.
* **Transportation \& Scheduling:** Coordinate transportation logistics and routing to ensure patients arrive safely and on time for program activities.
* **Documentation \& Data Entry:** Maintain accurate electronic records, complete required Electronic Health Record (EHR) data entry, and generate operational reports as requested.
* **Inclusive Environment:** Champion an inclusive, welcoming culture for all patients and community members, demonstrating sensitivity to diversity and intersectionality within the community.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnering:** Work collaboratively with management and center staff to enhance program quality, operational efficiency, and overall team success.
* **Frontline Engagement:** Serve as a warm, professional point of contact for patients, families, and visiting partners, assisting with basic translation or interpretation as needed if bilingual.
* **Compliance \& Safety:** Maintain a clean, orderly workspace and comply with all administrative, safety, background clearance, and health screening protocols (including TB testing).
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Certifications**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Age Requirement:** Must be at least 18 years of age.
* **Certifications:** Active CPR and First Aid Certifications (required upon hire).
* **Clearances:** Ability to clear a standard background check and obtain required medical clearances (including health screening and TB test).

#### **Experience \& Technical Skills**

* **Administrative Background:** Minimum of one (1\) year of administrative, coordinator, or office support experience.
* **Computer Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, electronic scheduling systems, EHR platforms, and standard office technology.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a warm, professional, and patient\-centered demeanor.
* **Adaptability \& Organization:** Highly organized with exceptional multi\-tasking skills, able to prioritize effectively in a busy environment with frequent interruptions.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* **Community Specialty:** 2 to 4 years of experience working in healthcare, adult day care, or senior care settings, with a preferred focus or demonstrated interest in serving LGBTQ seniors.
* **Bilingual Ability:** Fluency in a second language is a strong plus (capable of providing basic translation for patients and staff).

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time Position (Contract).
* **Work Setting:** On\-Site Ambulatory/Day Center Environment.
* **Schedule:** Full\-time (Monday– Friday \- shift schedule).

**If you're interested, please reply to this advertisement or directly email your resume to me at DSalgado@teemagroup.com or by calling/texting (949\) 295\-5951\.**  

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**
