jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, DoorDash for Business
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash for Business (DDfB) is one of DoorDash's fastest\-growing businesses, helping organizations engage and support their employees through meal benefits, workplace catering, gifting, and other workplace solutions. As companies invest in employee engagement and return\-to\-office initiatives, we're expanding our product offerings, launching internationally, and building toward a one\-stop solution for corporate workplace needs. Joining this team means joining a startup within DoorDash \- you'll have the ownership and speed of a high\-growth business backed by the scale, resources, and brand of a global leader.


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for an Inbound Sales Development Representative to join our DoorDash for Business team, focused on converting inbound interest into qualified pipeline within Mid Market to Strategic accounts. You'll work inbound leads within SLA, quickly assessing fit and intent before they ever reach an Account Executive. As DDfB's first line of communication for prospects who've already raised their hand, you'll shape their first impression of us and run structured discovery conversations that set our sales team up for success. You'll also take on periodic outbound\-oriented projects tied to DoorDash for Business growth and GTM testing, using our existing playbook.



You will report into the Business Development Manager in our pre\-sales organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own inbound leads from the moment they hit your queue, working within defined SLAs to make first contact, qualify, and route \- speed and responsiveness are the job, not a nice\-to\-have
* Qualify inbound interest against clear criteria\- and just as importantly, disqualify quickly and cleanly so sales time goes to the accounts worth pursuing
* Run structured discovery on inbound conversations to understand intent and need, then hand off well\-briefed, sales\-ready meetings to Account Executives
* Take on side projects tied to DDfB growth and GTM testing — new channel experiments, campaign tests, and initiatives that pull on outbound prospecting and multi\-touch outreach skills alongside your core inbound work
* Partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to close the loop on lead quality, surfacing patterns in what's converting (and what isn't) back to the team
* Participate in ongoing sales training and coaching to develop your skills in qualification, discovery, and objection handling plus occasional outbound fundamentals to support cross\-functional project work and promotion

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have 6 months\+ of experience in B2B sales, SDR/BDR, or a related inbound sales environment
* You have a track record of meeting or exceeding activity, SLA and conversion pipeline goals in a quota\-driven environment
* You can quickly assess fit and intent on a lead — and you're comfortable disqualifying as confidently as you qualify
* You are proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach, and use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to support process, qualification and prospecting
* You're adaptable \- equally comfortable reacting fast to an inbound queue and picking up structured outbound work when a growth or GTM test calls for it
* You have a resilient, gritty mindset and thrive navigating complexity and ambiguity in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment


Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.description:

At Finout, we’re not just shedding light on spend—we’re giving companies the power to make smarter, faster, and more strategic decisions about the cloud.  

We’re trusted by brands like **The New York Times, Wiz, Elastic, SiriusXM**, and **Lyft**, and backed by top\-tier investors with over $85M raised. In just 4 years, we’ve grown to 100\+ people across Tel Aviv and New York—and we’re just getting started.  

**If you’re looking to build something big, solve real problems, and grow fast \-we’d love to meet you.**

**About the Role**
------------------


As an SDR you will manage the sales pipeline, from lead to sales\-qualified opportunity. You will be the first line of communication with potential partners and customers and will work closely with sales leadership to meet aggressive growth goals. The position is in the general New York City area and requires 3 days a week in our Midtown office.


We offer a competitive salary and commission structure, salary range will be around $60,000 \- $100,000, annually.

-------------------

* Conduct research to identify potential target clients
* Proactively reach out to prospects via email, phone, and social media to create interest in our platform
* Qualify leads based on specific criteria and schedule appointments for the sales team
* Collaborate with the marketing team to refine and develop targeted messaging and campaigns
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in our CRM system

---------------------------

* Driven to success, full of energy, and passionate about supporting and closing sales

--------------

  

We're a hybrid company with a big vision and a startup soul. If you’re excited to help shape the future of cloud infrastructure and join a team that cares deeply about what (and how) we build—we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
### **About TouchCare**



TouchCare is a healthcare concierge and benefits advocacy company making healthcare easier to navigate. For more than a decade, we've helped employees and their families understand and maximize their benefits while helping employers deliver a better healthcare experience.



Now, we're growing—and expanding our Sales team to help bring TouchCare to more employers across the country.


### **The Opportunity**



We're looking for a **Sales Development Representative (BDR)** to join our growing Sales team in **NYC.**



You'll be on the front lines of TouchCare's growth—connecting with brokers and benefits professionals, opening new relationships, and generating opportunities for our Sales team.



This is an opportunity to **learn B2B / B2C sales from experienced leaders, become an expert in the healthcare and benefits industry, and build toward an Account Executive career path.**


### **What You'll Do**


* Identify and connect with brokers, benefits professionals, and prospective partners through **phone, email, LinkedIn, and industry events**.
* Research target accounts and create thoughtful, personalized outreach.
* Qualify inbound and outbound prospects and generate meetings for our Sales team.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospects who may not be ready to buy today.
* Partner closely with Account Executives on messaging, account strategy, and prospecting.
* Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, and lead\-generation initiatives.
* Become an expert on TouchCare, our solutions, buyers, and competitive landscape.
* Maintain accurate activity and pipeline information in our CRM.
* Meet and exceed activity, meeting, and pipeline goals.

### **What You'll Bring**


* **2–5 years of sales, business development, or related experience**; B2B experience preferred.
* Strong communication skills and confidence starting conversations with new people.
* A competitive, goal\-oriented mindset and desire to succeed.
* Curiosity, coachability, resilience, and strong follow\-through.
* Ability to research prospects and create personalized outreach.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology, or SaaS experience is a plus.
* Excitement about working **onsite in our Stamford office five days per week**.

### **Why TouchCare?**



TouchCare has **10\+ years of success** behind us and an exciting period of growth ahead.



You'll join a collaborative team, work directly alongside experienced Sales and company leaders, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on our growth. We see Business Development as a **launching point for future sales talent**, with opportunities for high performers to grow into Account Executive and other sales roles as we scale.



If you're **competitive, curious, coachable, and ready to build your sales career**, we'd love to meet you.


**Compensation:** $60,000–$70,000 base salary, based on experience and qualifications.


**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, paid time off, parental leave, and other company\-sponsored benefits.


**Location:** NYC \| **Onsite 5 days per week**


*TouchCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any legally protected status.*

jobs.title: REMOTE SALES REPRESENTATIVE (Virtual Healthcare Services)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


CompassionMD™ provides affordable, direct virtual medical care to individuals, families, small businesses, and large organizations nationwide. Our model gives people 24/7 access to board\-certified doctors, virtual urgent care, mental health consultations, medical guidance, and other valuable health services at predictable, transparent pricing.


We are expanding across the United States and are seeking motivated **Sales Representatives** who can introduce our direct virtual care programs to consumers and to organizations of all sizes.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


This is a **sales\-focused**, **remote**, **performance\-based** role suited for someone who:

* Has an existing client base, business network, or broad community influence
* Has experience selling to **individuals**, **small businesses**, or **mid\-to\-large organizations**
* Is comfortable offering a subscription\-based virtual healthcare program
* Wants to build **recurring residual income** through ongoing membership renewals
* Prefers flexible work hours and autonomy


You will present, promote, and help enroll people and organizations into CompassionMD™ virtual health subscription plans.

**What You’ll Sell**
--------------------


Our direct virtual care programs include:

* 24/7 doctor access
* Virtual urgent care
* Medical guidance \& care navigation
* Mental health consultations
* Prescription support
* Hospital bill negotiation services
* Additional associated benefits


Plans are priced to be affordable for individuals, families, and organizations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Sell CompassionMD™ virtual health subscriptions nationwide
* Conduct outreach to individuals, families, and organizations
* Present our services to small and mid\-sized businesses (bulk enrollment options)
* Work with groups, associations, nonprofits, and employers
* Manage your own leads or use your existing network
* Track enrollments and customer follow\-up
* Collaborate with internal support teams for onboarding

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

* Experience in **sales**, **benefits**, **healthcare**, **insurance**, **affiliate marketing**, or **business development**
* Strong existing network or the ability to build one
* Excellent communication skills
* Professional, organized, and self\-motivated
* Comfortable working independently
* Tech\-savvy and confident presenting virtually

*No healthcare license is required.*

**Compensation**
----------------

* **Performance\-based commissions**
* **Monthly residual income** for active subscribers you enroll
* **Unlimited** earning potential tied directly to your production
* All commission structures are fully disclosed during the interview

**Why This Role Appeals to Top Salespeople**
--------------------------------------------

* Work entirely from home
* National market—no territory limitations
* Highly relevant product (healthcare is universally needed)
* Subscription model allows ongoing monthly earnings
* Strong value proposition for individuals AND businesses
* Backed by a national virtual health platform

Bridge City Sightseeing is building a professional field\-sales team serving New York City’s tourism and attractions market.

We are looking for confident, energetic and dependable sales professionals who enjoy meeting people, working in a fast\-paced environment and earning based on performance.

**What You’ll Do**

Engage visitors face\-to\-face in New York City’s tourism areas.

Ask questions to understand what visitors want to experience.

Present attraction and sightseeing options clearly and professionally.

Convert customer conversations into ticket sales.

Maintain excellent customer service while representing Bridge City Sightseeing.

Learn and follow the Bridge City sales system.

Track individual sales activity and performance.

**Who We’re Looking For**

Candidates with experience in outside sales, tourism, attractions, hospitality, promotions, events, telecom, door\-to\-door sales or other face\-to\-face sales environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant I
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
  

  

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side\-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  

  

Are you ready to make your impact?


**About The Role**

This position is responsible for providing superior administrative support for Senior Managing Directors/Managing Directors and other leaders as assigned, as well as providing general New York City office administrative support for the Strategic Communications segment of FTI. The position will handle all administrative functions and will require the ability to successfully balance assignments and a variety of tasks from multiple individuals. This role will be responsible for routine and non\-routine tasks and will require independent judgment to plan, prioritize and organize workload. The Executive Assistant may interact with clients and other FTI executive leaders and will be required to maintain absolute discretion and confidentiality as would be expected of a professional in this role.


**What You’ll Do**

Primary Duties:


**General Administration**

* Heavy calendar management, often with competing schedules and appointments. This support requires a proactive attitude and an eye for attention to detail with the ability to independently prioritize.
* Maintenance and management of contact lists in Outlook for multiple leaders; updating as needed
* Coordinate and manage meetings, logistics, schedules, conference calls
* Coordinate travel arrangements
* Create and maintain paper and electronic files
* Support in\-office staff as requested/needed in adherence with on\-site schedules and direction from EA Regional Lead.
* Liaise with reception and facilities/office manager and regional Administrative Assistant
* Select and coordinate catering for meetings and special events in adherence with budgetary parameters and Strategic Communications best practices
* Collaborate with general manager for office functions and provide support as needed
* Coordinate and manage internal and external events and meetings, as requested
* Troubleshoot real\-time issues and direct team members to appropriate channels for resolution
* Respond to various verbal or email requests in a timely and professional manner
* Manage and enter time in Carpe Diem Web (time entry system) for senior leaders
* Collaborate with Strategic Communications administrative and core operations teams to provide the highest level of support
* Provide general team support to assigned practice(s) including, but not limited to:
* Taking notes and circulating action items from team meetings
* Drafting contracts
* Data entry
* Proofreading and materials creation
* External and internal meeting preparation and collateral production
* All other duties as assigned

**Financial Administration**

* Set up new clients/manage contacts (Salesforce)
* Assist with client invoice processing, vendor setups
* Manage expense reports (Emburse software)

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.


We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.


We're looking for a **Lead Clinical Operations Specialist** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.


Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------


As our business grows, so does the need for smoother, more consistent imaging workflows across the specialized case types we support — from image acquisition through final report delivery. The **Lead Clinical Operations Specialist** serves as a dedicated owner for those workflows: someone who deeply understands the operational nuances of case handling, brings clarity and structure to how the team works, and serves as the go\-to expert others can lean on as we grow.

* Personally handle a meaningful share of the core Lead Clinical Operations Specialist workload — cross\-referencing patient, imaging center, and radiologist information against customer data, client updates, and radiology group communication
* Own the quality bar for the entire team's output, not just your own — build the checks, spot\-audits, and feedback loops that catch errors before they reach a client
* Be the escalation point for imaging center and radiology group issues — the ones that don't get resolved by following the standard playbook
* Build and maintain the SOPs and training materials that make this scalable
* Identify where AI and agentic workflows can absorb manual QC and data cross\-referencing work.
* Work with sensitive data in line with HIPAA requirements, and hold your team to the same standard

**THE TOP 3 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Prove you can do the job before you build it — within your first 90 days, be able to competently execute the tasks presented
* Build a quality system (not just personal vigilance) so the team hits the accuracy bar on its own output, and can show a downward trend in team\-level errors and escalations over the year.
* Drive toward making part of this role's manual work obsolete — identify and ship at least one AI\-assisted or automated workflow that removes manual cross\-referencing or QC work from the team's plate.

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------


You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Experience in healthcare operations, managing sensitive data in a client service function. Clinical knowledge of radiology with direct clinical experience is strongly preferred.
* A track record of personally doing detail\-critical work at a high accuracy bar — you lead by example, not just by oversight
* Experience building or improving SOPs, training, and quality\-control processes for a growing team
* Comfort using AI tools to remove drudgery from your own and your team's workflow, with sound judgment on where it helps and where it doesn't — especially around sensitive patient data
* Strong data manipulation — Pivot Tables and VLOOKUPs are a baseline, not a differentiator, for this role
* Direct, low\-ego communication — comfortable giving and receiving hard feedback without letting it fester
* Resilience and a bias for action in ambiguity — this is a scale\-up, and the role will evolve under you

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------


At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. For a member of this team, that means using AI daily to draft, check, and move faster. For the person leading this team, the bar is higher: you're expected to see where AI and agentic tooling can restructure the work itself, not just speed up your own tasks.

**Tier 3 — AI\-Building**


You use AI daily in your own work, and you actively identify and help build automations or agentic workflows that change how your team operates — not just personal productivity gains. You know how to evaluate whether an AI\-driven process is safe and reliable enough for sensitive patient data before rolling it out to the team.

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------


We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. For you to be successful at Scan.com you must embody our values.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

**Always Play Offense**

* You don't quit on hard problems. Fail fast, dust off, go again.
* You celebrate wins, then seek the next opportunity.
* You see it, you fix it. No task is beneath you, at any level.

* Talent recognizes talent. You actively bring quality hires into the business.
* You trust your colleagues to deliver.
* You open\-source your knowledge. You're never a single point of failure.

* Strong opinions, weakly held. You welcome challenge and feedback.
* You get to the point: direct challenge plus an alternative solution.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
FlexTG \| Position Description**CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGER**


Modern Position Description

 **Position Title**

  

Client Relationship Manager

 **Department**

  

Sales / Client Account Management

 **FLSA Status**

  

Exempt

 **Travel**

  

As needed to support client and internal business needs

 **COMPANY OVERVIEW**


FlexTG provides managed print and workplace technology services with a national footprint. Our teams are focused on delivering a consistent client experience, strong operational execution, and practical solutions that help customers run their business more effectively.

**JOB SUMMARY**


The Client Relationship Manager, or CRM, is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients after implementation. The CRM is responsible for customer satisfaction, retention, account growth, day\-to\-day account activity, issue resolution, internal coordination, and overall account health.


This role combines relationship management, operational follow\-through, account planning, business review preparation, data analysis, and cross\-functional leadership. The CRM works closely with Sales, Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Billing, Contracts, Project Management, and Leadership to make sure client needs are understood, documented, prioritized, and driven to resolution.

**Role Focus**


A successful CRM keeps the client experience organized, responsive, and professional while protecting revenue, identifying opportunities, and ensuring internal teams have clear direction on account priorities. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Relationship and Account Ownership**

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned client accounts.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with executive sponsors, operational stakeholders, site contacts, and end\-user communities.
* Understand each client’s business objectives, contract scope, service expectations, billing requirements, technology goals, and operational priorities.
* Own customer satisfaction, retention, growth, profitability, and overall account health for the assigned client portfolio.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all aspects of the contractual relationship with the customer.

**Operational Support and Issue Resolution**

* Support customers’ day\-to\-day needs with clear communication, urgency, and ownership.
* Coordinate internal resources to fulfill service level agreements, resolve client issues, and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Provide the interface between customers, end users, technical support, service, operations, and other internal resources.
* Investigate customer complaints or concerns, develop practical solutions, and manage open items through completion.
* Escalate high\-risk service, supply, billing, contract, or operational issues appropriately while maintaining client communication.

**Business Reviews and Account Planning**

* Prepare for and lead regular client business reviews, executive partnership reviews, account planning sessions, and strategic check\-ins.
* Use reporting, metrics, and account data to bring value to the client and align recommendations with short\-term and long\-term technology goals.
* Identify risks, opportunities, usage trends, service patterns, supply activity, billing concerns, and areas for improvement.
* Develop clear action plans for renewals, expansions, fleet changes, program improvements, and additional phases of business.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Sales, Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Billing, Contracts, Project Management, and Leadership to ensure a coordinated approach to customer needs.
* Support onboarding for new customers and partner with implementation teams on deployment, inventory collection, device management, consumables management, and service readiness.
* Communicate client feedback, operational gaps, and process improvement opportunities to the appropriate internal teams.
* Recommend and help implement operational practices that improve productivity, efficiency, cost control, service quality, and customer outcomes.

**Documentation, Reporting, and Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate account documentation, meeting notes, action items, contact records, contract details, fleet information, and follow\-up commitments.
* Use Microsoft 365, CRM systems, reporting platforms, and internal business systems to manage account information and prepare client\-facing materials.
* Document current\-state and future\-state business processes when needed to support client planning, program changes, and internal alignment.
* Develop continual process improvements that strengthen the customer experience and improve internal execution.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

* Strong client relationship management skills with the ability to build trust and credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with client executives and operational contacts.
* Strong customer focus, sound judgment, and a sense of urgency in all work.
* High level of organization, follow\-through, and ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, deadlines, and open issues at the same time.
* Strong analytical and reasoning abilities with the ability to review data, identify trends, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience managing projects with cross\-functional or multi\-disciplined team members.
* Ability to develop and strengthen customer relationships while balancing client needs, contractual requirements, and business outcomes.
* Comfortable working independently, remotely, and across multiple internal departments.
* Professional presence, mature judgment, flexibility, and well\-developed interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Experience with CRM, ERP, service management, reporting, or managed print platforms preferred.

**ED

jobs.title: Field Operations Specialist (North West Atlanta)
jobs.description:
**Your career has a home here.**

Ready to make an impact with a dynamic, forward\-thinking company?


As a leading property manager of single\-family rental homes nationwide, we take great pride in creating an enjoyable living experience for our residents – and an empowering, people\-first culture for our team members. That’s why, for two years in a row, our employees have voted Progress a certified Great Place to Work®.


**Why join Progress?**

As the demand for professionally managed rental homes continues to grow, so do the opportunities at Progress. We’re looking for passionate professionals who are ready to grow with us, make a difference and be part of something meaningful.

**Want to learn more?**

Text “ProgressJobs” to 25000 to chat with Kate, our AI Recruiting Assistant. She can help you explore open roles, apply, and answer your questions in real time.

**Position Summary:**


The **Field Operations Specialist (FOS)** is a field role that ensures Progress homes are secure and in a marketable leasing condition. The FOS is responsible for walking vacant homes, performing home inspections, and re\-keying homes prior to resident move\-in. They ensure that vacant Progress homes are ready to rent. This role requires basic maintenance and repair skills, such as the ability to change smoke detector batteries, light bulbs and filters or winterization of homes.

**Essential Functions:**

* Walks assigned homes to ensure that vacant on\-market homes are move\-in ready.
* Conducts quality control, move\-in inspections, home curation, and cataloging.
* Demonstrates basic maintenance and repair skills such as minor repairs to home (changing smoke detector batteries, light bulbs, filters, winterization, etc.)
* Prepares home for scheduled move\-in by identifying any issues, removing signage, re\-keying and managing keys, reprograming garage remotes, etc.
* Submits vacant service requests, as needed.
* Performs light cleans to ensure asset shows well and is prepared for new resident, such as sweeping, wiping surfaces, trash removal, etc., as applicable.
* Verifies utilities are connected which may include meeting utility vendors at homes to allow access.
* Ensures Smart Home systems are operational and follows Lock and Security Device Policy.
* Installs/Removes portable self\-show lockboxes, as applicable.
* Inspects homes for scam activity and ensures marketing home materials are present, to include fraud signs.
* Performs occupancy checks, as needed, on eviction homes or those suspected of skip or trespasser; to include taking photos and communicating home status to applicable team members.
* Posts notices on home and communicates status with photos to applicable team members.
* Appears at eviction lockouts, as needed.
* Follows Fleet vehicle maintenance schedule, keep an organized and clean vehicle/workspace , and manage Fleet inventory within company guidelines.
* May also be responsible for administrative functions in customer service.

**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Minimum of 1 year experience in either property management or a maintenance/inspections related field.
* Must have reliable transportation.
* Property maintenance and repair skillset preferred.
* Experience in customer service preferred.
* Comfortable with Technology (Salesforce and Yardi knowledge a plus).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required.
* Always maintain valid auto insurance.
* Willingness to drive safely and follow the company’s fleet driving policies.
* Capability to prioritize workload in a fast\-paced work environment.
* Ability to work without direct supervision, adhere to the provided schedule, and efficiently complete all assigned tasks within the designated timeframe.

**Physical Demands:**

* Standing, walking, and/or sitting for extended periods of time
* Moderate climbing, reaching, and use of fingers
* Moderate stooping, kneeling, crawling, pushing, pulling, lifting, talking, and hearing
* Sustains substantially recurring movement to fingers, hands, wrists, legs, and feet
* Ability to judge distances and spatial relationships
* Ability to identify and distinguish color
* Ability to distinguish the differences or similarities in odors
* Ability to lift and/or move 50 pounds or more
* Ability to use standard maintenance equipment

**What you can expect from us:**

* **Competitive Compensation** \- Including performance\-based bonuses that reward your contributions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package** \- Medical, dental, vision, parental leave, 401(k) with company match and more.
* **Generous Time Off** – Enjoy PTO based on tenure, 13 paid holidays and 1 floating holiday.
* **Ongoing Learning and Development** \- Quarterly summits, town hall meetings and continuous training to support your professional growth.
* **A Culture that Celebrates You** \- We believe in collaboration, recognition and having fun while doing important work.

This summary is not an all\-inclusive description of job duties. Other job duties and responsibilities may also be assigned by the incumbent’s supervisor at any time based upon Company need.


Employment with Progress Residential is conditional on a satisfactory background and drug screen.


Progress Residential is a proud Equal Opportunity employer, m/f/d/v.

jobs.title: Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title: Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator


Location: Naperville, Illinois


Department: Shelter


Reports To: Executive Director


FLSA Status: Full Time/Part\-time, Non\-exempt


Pay Range: $17\.00\-$19\.00 DOE


About Us:


A.D.O.P.T. is a private, non\-profit 501(c)(3\) organization that has found homes for more than 30,000 pets. We provide a temporary, loving home for dogs and cats that no longer have a family of their own. The animals in our shelter have ended up here for a variety of reasons ranging from abandonment, to rescue from an abusive situation, to owner surrender because they no longer are able to take care of them. Our animals are loving, family pets who are desperately awaiting for their forever home.


A.D.O.P.T. was founded in 1989 by a group of dedicated volunteers determined to find homes for animals in need. Over the years, our objective has remained the same: to place animals into permanent, caring homes and advance the humane treatment of animals through education.


Job Purpose:


The Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator shall be responsible for the coordination, orientation and scheduling of all A.D.O.P.T. volunteers for shelter support, clinic assistance, programming and fundraising events. This role will also plan, coordinate and participate in the activities of any after\-school or weekend programs and summer day camps of A.D.O.P.T. The position will require collaborative efforts with parents and staff. This role is key in providing education for youth, groups and overall community.


Duties \& Responsibilities:

* Training, scheduling, and supervising of front desk, animal care and administrative volunteers.
* Recruiting of new volunteers
* Management of record keeping for volunteers through Volgistics
* Scheduling and presentation of volunteer orientation to be held monthly
* Assisting with events and activities as needed
* Meeting and greeting visitors to the shelter
* Management of community service volunteer program
* Coordinates volunteer recognition programs
* Management of corporate volunteer groups
* Conducts informational sessions for potential volunteers and speaks with various groups regarding volunteer opportunities, animal adoption and rescue awareness
* Handling and addressing conflicts that arise within volunteer groups.
* Work with the Executive Director, Shelter Operations Manager and Animal Program Instructor on developing and directing youth outreach programming for K through 12th grade, including but not limited to youth programs, special events centered around animal welfare and humane education.
* Coordinate and manage schedules and activities of programs and summer day camps.
* Provide supervision for after\-school programs and summer day camps. This would also require coordinating staffing necessary for programs.
* Coordinate and manage all summer camp applications for families and the community.
* Maintain detailed enrollment records for all programming, including after\-school program and summer day camps.
* Responsible for recording and processing information relative to statistics, finances, communications, and evaluation for all programming.
* Create weekly and monthly program schedules for all programs, including detailed after\-school programs and summer day camp schedules.
* Troubleshoot logistics of our animals’ arrival and finding available foster homes.
* Provide foster families with everything they’ll need, like:
* Information and advice on caring for animals using fear\-free methods, common animal medical concerns to be aware of, reading animal behavior, etc.
* Loading them up with the basics: food, litter, bedding, toys, and more.
* Making the introduction to their new furry foster!
* Respond to foster families’ questions and concerns with urgency.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to triage any medical and/or behavioral concerns of foster animals. Attend events to promote our foster program and recruit more foster families.
* Help organize foster\-based adoption events to find our animals forever families!
* Ensure all material used in any programming aligns with A.D.O.P.T’s mission and vision statements.
* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that fosters and maintains positive relationships with co\-workers and supervisors. This would include but not be limited to such actions:
* resolution of conflicts in a positive manner;
* courteous treatment of staff, clients, and visitors;
* respect of others' property and person;
* professional and appropriate communication to and about co\-workers, supervisors, and subordinates.
* Support the Mission of A.D.O.P.T. by treating every donor, contact and colleague with respect and dignity, and without discrimination of any kind.
* Additional duties as assigned
* Duties and responsibilities may change, and new ones may be added, at any time with or without advanced notice.


Skills \& Qualifications

* A.D.O.P.T. functions seven days per week, evening or weekend hours will be necessary on occasion
* Ability to work as a team player with other staff and volunteers
* A positive attitude and the ability to be flexible changing job positions/priorities.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Uses diplomacy and good judgment.
* Demonstrated ability to use initiative and be a self\-starter.
* Attention to detail, procedures, processes, and policies.
* Possess a basic knowledge of dog/cat breed characteristics and behaviors
* Possess safe animal handling skills and be comfortable interacting with all varieties and temperaments of dogs and cats while maintaining a safe, calm, and humane work environment
* Experience training and supervising volunteers
* Customer service experience preferred
* College or advanced degree preferred
* Experience with animal foster programs
* Minimum of two years' experience in youth work considered in lieu of re

**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Operations Coordinator Nurse**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

  

Under the clinical direction of the Medical Director and the administrative direction of the Practice Manager, the Operations Coordinator, Nurse participates in the planning, leading, and organizing of activities relating to quality patient care in the practice. S/he supervises and personally provides nursing care in the practice.

  

The Operations Coordinator Nurse will be responsible for supervising the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising clinical and administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, manage practice collections, ensure service excellence and perform service recovery as necessary.

  

Position manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks. Responsible for front\-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity. Position may perform staff work in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Supervise and direct the office’s front\-line clinical and clerical staff.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
* Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
* Assist with managing providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
* Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co\-pays and patient balances, in\-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
* Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
* Manage office and medical surgical supplies within budget
* Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
* Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis.
* Attend and actively participate in manager/supervisor meetings.
* Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.
* Additional Functions
	+ Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
	+ Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
	+ Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one to one coaching and mentoring.
	+ Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc)
	+ Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with procedures.
	+ Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
	+ Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost\-savings, and operational efficiencies.
	+ Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed to support the practice.
	+ Complete other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of three years work experience in a medical or related business
* Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO,PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, Medicaid
* Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office
* Leadership experience
* Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel
* Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.
* Current License as Registered Professional Nurse in state employed in.
* CPR

  

**Preferred:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Knowledge of coding
* Supervisory experience

  

**Additional Information**  

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**


Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. We’re looking for a Full\-time Administrative Coordinator who loves working with people, warm, energetic, organized, enjoys being part of a fast\-paced team, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional patient experience.

* Loves helping and lead people and creating positive experiences
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced, energetic environment
* Has a positive attitude and team\-first mindset
* Is dependable, organized, and detail oriented
* Communicates confidently and compassionately
* Takes initiative and enjoys learning and growing

* Oversee daily administrative operations, workflows, and administrative systems

* Create a positive first and lasting impression for every patient and team member part of our office
* Train and coach administrative team members on next\-level patient experience
* Monitor and drive KPIs, revenue goals, and bonus tracking
* Collaborate on marketing initiatives and patient growth strategies
* Manage financial processes
* Maintain accurate patient experience standards, addressing concerns and feedback
* Conduct regular audits (charts, communications, A/R, and operational metrics)
* Participate in improvement of systems and protocols
* Lead and participate in creating a fun, positive, and team\-oriented office environment

**Position Overview:**


Green Office Partner, ranked the **\#1** Best Place to Work by Crain’s (2023,24,25 \& 26\) and the Chicago Sun\-Times (2024 \& 2025\), is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Post\-Sales Operations \& Implementation Coordinator (OTI Coordinator**) to manage the critical transition from a signed customer agreement through installation readiness and final project closeout.


We deliver HP and Xerox Managed Print Services, Intelligent Document Processing, and Conference Room/Audio\-Video Solutions that help enterprises reduce costs, increase efficiency, and modernize their workplaces.


The **OTI Coordinator** serves as the operational connection between **Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success**, ensuring every new customer order is accurate, properly staged, internally aligned, and ready for successful implementation.


This role owns the post\-signature coordination process—including order verification, system setup, internal kickoff meetings, client onboarding coordination, milestone tracking, and final Delivery \& Acceptance documentation.


The ideal candidate enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, coordinating multiple departments, communicating directly with clients, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Order Staging:** Review signed agreements for accurate equipment, leasing, billing, and customer information.
* **System Setup:** Coordinate post\-sale customer setup and updates across CRM, ERP, and monitoring systems.

* **Client Onboarding:** Co\-lead the customer kickoff, confirm scope and site requirements, and transition installation to the Project Manager.
* **Project Tracking:** Monitor key milestones and help resolve outstanding operational items throughout implementation.
* **Project Closeout:** Secure signed Delivery \& Acceptance (D\&A) documentation and submit completed packages to Finance.
* **Lease Returns:** Coordinate final payments, LOIs, timing, and documentation for equipment returns when applicable.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in **order management, sales operations, project coordination, customer onboarding, or a similar operational role**.
* Experience working with CRM, ERP, order\-management, or related business systems.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple customer projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively between Sales, Finance, Operations, Purchasing, and Project Management.
* Professional client\-facing communication skills and confidence participating in customer onboarding meetings.
* Ability to identify missing information, resolve operational issues, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable working in a process\-driven environment where documentation accuracy and timely follow\-through are critical.

**What Success Looks Like**


Success in this role means that when a customer signs an agreement, the transition into implementation feels **organized, professional, and seamless**.


Orders are accurate. Internal teams know their responsibilities. Customers understand what happens next. Project Managers receive complete information. Installations move forward without avoidable delays. And final documentation is completed quickly so the project can be properly closed and funded.


The **OTI Coordinator** is the person who **connects all of those pieces together.**

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Performance\-based compensation opportunities where applicable.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits.
* 401(k) retirement savings program with competitive employer matching.
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and company\-paid holidays.
* Company\-supported professional development and training opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment with direct exposure to Sales, Operations, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success leadership.

At Green Office Partner, we believe great customer experiences are created by great teams working together. The **OTI Coordinator** plays a central role in that experience—connecting the promise made during the sales process with the operational execution that follows.

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

* Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory

* Demonstrated knowledge of social justice, health promotion and public health approaches and models of social support and healt

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator – Youth Sports
jobs.description:
**Event Operations Supervisor – Youth Sports**

Help create unforgettable experiences for young athletes

We are looking for an organized, energetic Event Operations Coordinator to help bring hundreds of youth sports events to life each year.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys turning plans into great experiences. You will help prepare events, coordinate equipment and materials, work with facilities and vendors, support staff and coaches, and solve the real\-time details that keep an event running smoothly. Some weeks will be carefully planned; others will ask you to adjust quickly. In both cases, your work will matter to the athletes, families, coaches, and teammates counting on us.

You do not need to arrive knowing every part of our operation. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, cares about the details, and is excited to learn how excellent events come together.

What you’ll do

* Coordinate the operational details that help youth sports camps and special events run successfully.
* Prepare event plans, checklists, timelines, materials, equipment, and shipments.
* Track event readiness and follow key details through completion so teams know what is ready and what still needs attention.
* Coordinate with facilities, vendors, coaches, event staff, and internal teams before and during events.
* Help manage inventory, organize event supplies, and make sure materials reach the right event at the right time.
* Support travel, lodging, arrival schedules, parking, certificates of insurance, payments, and other event needs as assigned.
* Provide clear, timely updates when plans change or a teammate needs help.
* Help guide interns and seasonal team members during busy preparation periods.
* Respond to occasional event questions during evenings or weekends in peak season.
* Improve checklists, processes, and shared information so each event becomes easier to prepare and execute.
* Pitch in wherever needed. Our best event operators care more about helping the team succeed than about whose task something is.

You may be a great fit if you

* Enjoy coordinating many moving pieces and bringing order to a busy environment.
* Follow through reliably and take pride in getting the details right.
* Communicate with warmth, clarity, and good judgment.
* Can adjust priorities when new information arrives without losing sight of the larger goal.
* Are comfortable working independently while also knowing when to ask for help.
* Like practical, hands\-on work and are willing to help prepare, organize, receive, and move event materials.
* Work well with different personalities, including coaches, vendors, interns, and teammates.
* Are comfortable learning tools such as Trello, spreadsheets, and event\-management systems.
* Care about youth sports and the opportunity to create meaningful experiences for student\-athletes.

Experience in event operations, sports management, hospitality, travel coordination, facilities, inventory, or a similarly detail\-oriented role is helpful—but we also welcome applicants whose skills come from another setting. If this work sounds energizing and you believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you will learn our event calendar, systems, and standards; become a trusted owner of assigned event\-readiness work; help seasonal staff stay organized; and give the team confidence that important details will be carried through to completion.

Over time, you will take greater ownership of events and operational categories, anticipate needs before they become urgent, and help build better ways of working across the Event Operations team.

What you can expect from us

* Purpose\-driven work that directly supports young athletes and their families.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* Real responsibility and the opportunity to grow within a large, national youth sports operation.
* Variety: every event cycle brings new people, locations, and challenges.
* Health insurance and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

Schedule and physical requirements

This position is based in Chicago and generally works from the office 3–4 days per week, with additional in\-person availability during peak event\-preparation and shipping periods. Because our events often occur on weekends, occasional evening or weekend responsiveness is part of the role.

The position also includes hands\-on work with event supplies and equipment, including receiving, organizing, packing, and moving materials. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals.

About Us

We empower youth athletes through sports, leadership, and personal\-development experiences. Each year, we work with thousands of athletes, families, coaches, facilities, and partners across the country. Behind every successful event is a team that plans carefully, communicates clearly, and cares deeply about the experience we create.

If you want your work to be active, meaningful, and connected to a mission—and you enjoy being the person who helps make everything come together—we would love to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**Location:** Chicago, Illinois (hybrid; typically 3–4 days per week in office)  
**Job type:** Full\-time

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $62,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carrier Sales Representative

**Roots Logistics \| Chicago, IL**  
**Full\-Time \| Monday through Friday (Days Vary)**

In This Role as a National Account Manager you will work alongside an experienced Carrier Sales team responsible for securing reliable transportation capacity, negotiating rates, building carrier relationships, and supporting the successful movement of customer freight throughout North America.

This is a hands\-on role that requires strong communication, urgency, organization, negotiation skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and carrier relationships at the same time. You will be expected to perform the full responsibilities of a National Account Manager while also placing a strong emphasis on identifying, developing, and maintaining new carrier relationships.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working within a close\-knit team environment while taking personal ownership of growing their carrier network. Success in this role requires someone who can service today’s freight while continuously building the carrier relationships Roots Logistics will need tomorrow.

We are looking for someone who views every carrier conversation as an opportunity to build trust, strengthen our network, and create a long\-term partnership.

**Working for Roots Logistics**

At other large companies, employees can easily get lost among numerous departments and layers of management. That is not the case at Roots Logistics.

Although we manage a large and complex transportation operation, we maintain a collaborative team structure that allows employees to communicate seamlessly across departments and locations. Regardless of your job title, you will play an important role in helping the company move forward, meet customer expectations, and continuously improve its operations.

Our National Account Managers work closely together, sharing information, supporting one another, and helping the team secure the best possible transportation solutions for our customers. This is an environment where teamwork matters, individual effort is recognized, and your ability to build strong carrier relationships can directly contribute to the company’s growth.

**About Roots Logistics**

Roots Logistics is a growing transportation and freight brokerage company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. We provide dependable transportation solutions throughout North America by combining an experienced operations team, an extensive carrier network, industry\-leading technology, and around\-the\-clock support.

Our operation is supported by team members in Chicago, Miami, Tampa, Colombia, Serbia, and the Philippines. This structure allows us to provide continuous coverage and responsive service to our customers and carrier partners.

Our vision is to be a progressive company within the complex logistics industry by providing reliable, solutions\-driven service that exceeds our customers’ expectations. We are committed to building long\-term partnerships while creating an environment where employees can develop professionally, expand their skills, and advance their careers.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Work alongside other National Account Managers in a highly collaborative and team\-oriented environment.
* Secure qualified carrier capacity for customer shipments throughout North America.
* Communicate with carriers, dispatchers, drivers, owner\-operators, and fleet managers regarding available freight and equipment.
* Negotiate competitive and sustainable transportation rates.
* Match available carrier capacity with customer freight based on location, equipment type, timing, service requirements, and pricing.
* Prospect for and develop relationships with new carriers.
* Build a personal network of dependable carrier partners that can support recurring and future freight opportunities.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing carriers.
* Conduct regular outbound calls to identify available equipment and new transportation partners.
* Use load boards, referrals, internal systems, industry contacts, and outbound prospecting to source carrier capacity.
* Present available freight clearly and professionally to prospective carrier partners.
* Understand carrier needs, preferred lanes, equipment availability, and operational capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to convert transactional carrier relationships into consistent, long\-term partnerships.
* Assist with carrier onboarding and ensure all required information and documentation are completed.
* Confirm that carriers meet company, customer, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before being assigned freight.
* Work closely with Operations, Tracking, Customer Sales, and other internal teams to support successful load execution.
* Communicate shipment requirements, appointment information, routing instructions, and customer expectations accurately.
* Confirm carrier acceptance and verify that all load details are clearly understood.
* Monitor assigned shipments and remain engaged throughout the transportation process.
* Assist with resolving carrier\-related delays, service failures, missed appointments, fall\-offs, and communication issues.
* Recover loads when a scheduled carrier cancels or is unable to complete an assignment.
* Maintain accurate carrier, rate, shipment, and communication records within the company’s Transportation Management System.
* Provide timely and accurate updates to internal team members.
* Monitor freight market conditions, carrier availability, capacity changes, and transportation pricing.
* Meet established activity, carrier development, gross margin, service, and performance expectations.
* Demonstrate consistent attendance, dependability, professionalism, and punctuality.
* Perform additional duties as business needs require.

**Qualifications**

* One year of previous freight brokerage, carrier sales, dispatch, transportation, logistics, or related experience preferred.
* Experience

The **Business Development Representative (BDR)** plays a vital role in fueling our growth engine within Marketing. This position focuses on daily lead generation, administrative excellence, and seamless coordination with internal teams. Your mission: convert prospects into **Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)** through strategic outreach, nurturing, and leveraging marketing programs. Full support and training will be provided, offering growth paths in Marketing, Sales, and Business Development.

  



**Your Responsibilities**

**Lead Generation \& Outreach**

* Design and implement targeted InMail and email sequences.
* Prospect and prioritize leads with strong follow\-up and data accuracy.
* Book meetings through persuasive outreach and discovery.
* Research prospects to tailor communications effectively.
* Develop engaging messaging to boost campaign responses and generate SQLs.

**Campaign \& Pipeline Optimization**

* Track and analyze campaign metrics; refine tactics for better results.
* Utilize lead\-gen tools, social media, and databases to build pipeline.
* Maintain talk tracks and scripts to drive consistent outreach.
* Schedule demos and meetings for Sales teams at scale.

**Activity \& Performance Goals**

* Meet or exceed weekly targets for calls, lead qualification, and appointment setting.
* Collaborate on demand Gen campaigns—webinars, content, email, etc.
* Accurately record prospect activity in CRM and provide actionable insights.
* Stay informed about industry trends to sharpen outreach strategies.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Support presales activities and align with strategy formulation.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, and Ops teams to refine approach.
* Generate reports and scorecards to track pursuit progress.

**Adaptability \& Professionalism**

* Thrive in dynamic, high\-activity settings; handle rejection gracefully.
* Continuously seek feedback and development.
* Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* BS/BA in Business, Marketing, or related field.
* Prior B2B sales or marketing experience preferred—tech experience is a plus.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational, writing, and communication skills.
* Basic business acumen and consultative selling ability.
* Hustle, resilience, and drive to succeed.
* Proficiency with MS Office, CRM platforms, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Power BI, and LinkedIn.

**Other Requirements**

* Valid driver’s license, and reliable transportation.
* Flexibility in break schedule; standard hours 8 AM–5 PM with occasional extended availability.
* Capable of regular office tasks and light lifting (up to 15 lbs).
* Long periods of sitting and standing along with using other forms of technology.

**Benefits**

**GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week) and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in health benefits utilizing the Cigna network. Health options include a choice of 2 PPO plans or a High Deductible Health Plan with employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA). In addition, Dental benefits are available as well as a Vision PPO plan utilizing the EyeMed network. Proven also offers voluntary worksite benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, short\-term disability insurance, supplemental life and pet insurance. Additional offerings include an employee discount program, home and auto insurance services and commuter/transit FSA.

**EMPLOYER PROVIDED LIFE/AD\&D INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, Proven IT provides a flat $25,000 Life Insurance benefit, administered by BlueCross BlueShield, to all full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week). Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) benefit payments are determined based on the type of loss incurred and are payable up to the full Life Insurance benefit amount. Life and AD\&D Insurance coverage amounts are reduced at ages 65, 70 and 75\.

**EMPLOYER PROVIDED LTD:** Long\-Term Disability (LTD) insurance is an employer\-provided benefit and provides protection from loss of income in the event that an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or accident for a long period of time. The elimination period is 90\-days, and the maximum benefit is 60% of covered payroll up to $6000/month. This benefit is paid entirely by Proven IT and has no cost to the employee.

**EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM:** All employees may utilize the Disability Resource Services through Mutual of Omaha to assist themselves and their immediate family with convenient resources to help address emotional, legal and financial issues. Telephonic counseling and web\-based services are available as well as a limited number of geographically accessible face\-to\-face sessions.

**401K PLAN:** All employees are eligible after 120 days of service to contribute on either a pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) basis to the 401K plan, administered by Principal Financial Services. Proven offers an employer match equal to 100% of the first 3% of deferrals plus 50% of the next 2% of deferrals.

**FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES:** Proven IT partners with Merrill Lynch to offer financial advisement to all employees. Merrill Lynch financial advisors are available to assist employees at no cost, with their 401k and retirement questions.

**PERMISSIVE TIME OFF POLICY:** Proven provides a competitive paid time off policy for all full\-time regular employees after a 90\-day waiting period. Proven IT empowers their employees to work with their managers and team to coordinate all time off. Managers may impose a limit to requests for time off based on performance and tenure.

**PARENTAL LEAVE:** Proven IT offers a generous parental leave policy for new parents. After 24\-months of employment, Proven provides full\-time regular employees with 90\-days of paid Maternity leave and 10\-days of paid Paternity leave. Empl

jobs.description:
Beagle by Corgi (YC S24\) is vertically integrating the entire insurance \+ property technology industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly. Insurance is the largest un\-automated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $374M from Kindred, TCV, and others.

We’re hiring high\-energy early\-career sales reps to join our in\-person team in Chicago. This is a ground\-floor sales role where you’ll learn outbound, talk to property managers daily, and move fast.

Building something great requires working hard and we are meritocratic with very high standards. If you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow. We move quickly, care deeply about talent density, and hire people who want unusually high ownership.

**What we're looking for:** 

* Hunger and coachability over experience
* Confident communicator
* Thrives in high\-speed, high\-accountability roles
* Strong organization \+ follow\-through
* Must be authorized to work in the US.

**What you'll do:**

* Make outbound calls \+ book meetings with property managers
* Keep CRM updated daily
* Help accounts from deal\-close → onboarding → billing
* Clear blockers fast during onboarding
* Spot upsell opportunities

**Impact \& Speed:** Work in a fast\-paced environment where your contributions will have immediate, tangible effects on the company’s success.

**Growth Potential:** We move fast and our people do too. We prefer to promote rather than hire, and will likely have many new roles coming in the near future. Hit your numbers, path to AE, AM, Ops, or Leadership in 2\-6 months.

**Compensation**

$60\-$65k base (determined by experience \+ performance)

$95k\+ OTE

**Interview Process**

1 screening call → 1 simulated work trial → offer in less than 3 days. We move fast, no drawn\-out hiring processes.

**About Corgi Insurance**

Corgi is a full\-stack insurance carrier building better, faster insurance products for startups. We’re not a broker, so we underwrite and issue policies directly, with fewer handoffs and less friction. Cutting out intermediaries lets us tailor coverage to how companies actually operate and price risk more efficiently.

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
This is a remote role within the United States. US work authorization is required.

 **About VIATechnik:**


VIATechnik is on a mission to lead the built environment in creating a better future, today. We are one team of over 500 digital experts around the globe. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed architects, engineers, tradespersons, researchers, and business leaders. Together, we empower clients through high\-quality, high\-velocity experiences that consistently improve outcomes across the design, construction, and operations of buildings and infrastructure. Our clients include Amazon, Mars Wrigley, and National Geographic, the firms shaping the world's most ambitious projects.

 **Role Overview**


As an Assistant Project Manager for mechanical and plumbing scopes, you will support the delivery of BIM and VDC services for VIATechnik's trade contractor clients. You'll coordinate between VIATechnik's internal technical teams and client stakeholders, manage several workstreams at once, and translate technical outputs into clear next steps for the people building the work in the field.


Your day\-to\-day work keeps handoffs on schedule, surfaces issues early, and manages risk before it affects a project timeline. This role fits someone with a strong grasp of construction software and technical workflows who wants to stay close to delivery without doing hands on production modeling.

 **Employee Value Proposition**

**Purpose** \- You will shape how predictably trade contractors operate in high\-stakes construction environments. The coordination you drive between technical teams and clients has a real effect on field readiness, clash avoidance, and schedule performance.

**Growth** \- Strong performance here opens a path to senior delivery leadership within VIATechnik's project portfolio. As you build expertise, you can take on process innovation, internal capability development, cross project delivery governance, or strategic account leadership.

**Motivators** \- You will thrive in this role if you find meaning in visible impact on client outcomes and enjoy being the connective force between technical teams and trade contractor clients, in a structured yet dynamic environment.

 **Major Performance Objectives**

* Within your first ninety days, get up to speed on each client's expectations and the project management platforms in use, and set a predictable rhythm of updates that keeps deliverables, dependencies, and reviews on track.
* Within your first sixty days, build a shared way of working with internal technical teams and client stakeholders, including regular check ins, a clear path for resolving issues, and agreement on scope and change requests.
* Within your first ninety days, contribute to at least one company wide initiative focused on process improvement, delivery standardization, or knowledge sharing, and help produce a measurable improvement that benefits VIATechnik beyond your own projects.

 **Critical Subtasks**

* Conduct a 30 to 60 day audit of your active projects to assess delivery status, scope clarity, modeling workflows, and risk areas, then work with technical leads to correct what needs fixing.
* Serve as a steady point of contact for trade contractor clients, keeping them updated on deliverable status, upcoming reviews, and open decisions.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and review cycles across your projects, flagging timeline risk early and adjusting resourcing with technical leads as needed.
* Run structured syncs with internal technical team leads to align on client feedback, modeling questions, and production challenges before they become bottlenecks.
* Watch for scope creep and change requests, document them clearly, and work with Client Success or Account Management to keep pricing and delivery aligned.
* Lead debriefs after major milestones or project closeout and turn what you learn into updates to templates, checklists, or delivery methods the team can reuse.
* Look for ways AI and automation tools can improve delivery accuracy and reduce manual coordination, and pilot at least one idea within your first six months.

 **This Role Is a Strong Fit for You If**

* A minimum of 2 years experience.
* An associate or above in a related field.
* You have hands on experience with construction software and BIM or VDC workflows and can translate technical detail into next steps that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* You can manage several active projects at once without losing track of deadlines, dependencies, or who owns what.
* You are comfortable being the connective point between technical teams and clients, and you take ownership when something needs to move faster.
